reading.zh: 从左到右五步：value-safety 归一化取值，preconditions 判定前置条件，observation 做观测与状态估计，planning 出计划，runtime 驱动整轮循环；箭头是认知循环的前进方向。
reading.en: Five steps left to right: value-safety normalises inputs, preconditions checks the world preconditions, observation estimates state, planning produces the plan and runtime drives the whole loop; arrows point forward through the cycle.
